title: crev AI confirmation handoff v2 (compressed, batched)
description: A batch is one chat-completions request (API provider) or one line of .crev/ai-handoff/batches.jsonl (Cursor-skill fallback). Rule text is deduplicated per batch, items carry a minimal line-numbered window, identical rule+code pairs are collapsed into one item (dups), and verdicts are cached by content hash. There is no budget cap.

batch_id.description: sha256 of the items' cache keys (first 16 hex)

instructions.description: System prompt; embedded only in Cursor-skill exports (sent as the system message in API mode)

rules.description: Keyed by rule id; each rule appears once per batch

facts.description: Per build unit, only the version dimensions the batch's rules depend on

quote.description: Short verbatim phrase from the cited doc

id.description: Short finding id (first 12 hex of the fingerprint; full id on collision)

evidence.description: Repo-index evidence for engine=index rules (tool output, not code)

code.description: Line-numbered ('N|') window: ±context_lines around the match, common indent stripped, ≤max_snippet_chars, secrets scrubbed

dups.description: Other finding ids with identical rule+code; the verdict applies to all

id.description: Item id (or any full/short finding id of the item or its dups)
